title: Canonical zero-cycle class in derived global Hom
statement: Let $J$ be a ringed site, with module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], derived category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] and derived internal Hom [def-pur-derived-internal-hom]. Use the fixed Hom representative, product projections, functorial K-injective replacement $I(M)$ and its localization factorization from [def-coef-hom-representative-evaluation]. Define the class of a zero cycle $z$ of $\Gamma\mathcal Hom^\bullet(L,I(M))$ in $H^0R\Gamma R\mathcal Hom(QL,QM)$ by its ordinary cohomology class, the universal right-derived global-section unit, and the inverse of the actual Hom localization factorization. Evaluate $z$ in degree $p$ by its actual $(p,p)$ product projection and local Hom evaluation at the identity over each object. The canonical additive identification of [lem-pur-rhom-global-sections] is fixed uniquely by naturality and the following representative normalization: for a K-flat source [def-pc-kflat-complex], if $z$ evaluates componentwise to a chain map $f:L\to I(M)$, its class corresponds to $Q(f)$ followed by the inverse of the localized augmentation $QM\to QI(M)$. This defines the cycle-class construction and fixes the comparison; it introduces no second derived Hom or global cohomology functor.

source.place: Tag 08JA, RHom and global sections; injectives.tex Tag 079P, the universal derived unit. The canonical cycle-class construction fixes the H0 comparison in proof step 14 of lem-coef-derived-system-evaluation-calculus.

proof.text: Use the actual global-complex comparison with the external Hom complex. Its degree-zero product projections agree with the recorded component evaluation. The cycles map identifies every cycle with a chain map; the induced H0 map is the canonical quotient by homotopy, naturally in both complexes.

The universal derived-sections unit induces an H0 isomorphism on Hom from a K-flat complex into the fixed K-injective replacement, since that Hom complex is K-injective. For an arbitrary source, take a K-flat resolution. Hom into a K-injective complex sends its quasi-isomorphism to a quasi-isomorphism, and precomposition induces an isomorphism on homotopy classes. Naturality of the sections unit then proves the same H0 comparison for every source.

Maps in the homotopy category into the fixed K-injective replacement identify additively with maps in the derived category. Compose this identification with the inverse sections comparison and the actual localization factorization. Full faithfulness of precomposition by the product localization descends this natural isomorphism to derived inputs. Remove the harmless universe lifts.

Compute the descended isomorphism on a zero-cycle class using the actual localization factorization. The global-complex comparison sends its product projections to the components of its chain map, so its image is Q(f) followed by the inverse of the localized resolution augmentation.

The homology projection from cycles is an epimorphism and the sections comparison is invertible, hence all classes for complex inputs come from cycles. Every derived source is isomorphic to a K-flat representative and every target to a complex representative. Naturality transports any competing normalized equivalence to these inputs, where cycle surjectivity and normalization give equality.

proof_origin.description: D4 constructs the normalized comparison from the actual global-complex comparison, universal derived unit and localization factorization, then proves uniqueness using cycle surjectivity and K-flat representatives.
